mapper.select: SELECT ca.apply_id, CASE UPPER(COALESCE(q.external_status, '')) WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN 'REFUSED' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN 'FAIL' THEN 'FAILED' WHEN 'CANCEL' THEN 'CANCEL' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN '' THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE 'PROCESSING' END AS status FROM credit_application ca LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q1.apply_id, q1.external_status FROM credit_lender_status_query q1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT apply_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM credit_lender_status_query GROUP BY apply_id ) latest ON latest.apply_id = q1.apply_id AND latest.max_id = q1.id ) q ON q.apply_id = ca.apply_id WHERE ca.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY ca.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT loan_apply_id,status FROM loan_application WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rpt.loan_application_id) FROM repayment_plan_term rpt INNER JOIN loan_application la ON la.id=rpt.loan_application_id WHERE la.profile_id=#{profileId} AND rpt.term_status IN ('UNPAID','OVERDUE')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repayment_plan_term rpt INNER JOIN loan_application la ON la.id=rpt.loan_application_id WHERE la.profile_id=#{profileId} AND rpt.term_status IN ('UNPAID','OVERDUE') AND (rpt.term_status='OVERDUE' OR COALESCE(rpt.overdue_days,0)>0))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM loan_application WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND status='DISBURSED')
